text: After a friend's wedding, James Hoyt and Kristen McKay arrive at [his isolated childhood summer home|trigger|travelling somewhere remote], raw from the marriage proposal she has just turned down. Late at night a young woman knocks and asks for someone named Tamara, and soon [three masked strangers|images|dolls, masks and likenesses] circle the house, slash the tires and break in with an axe. With the phones gone and the car wrecked, [the couple are hunted room by room|rules|trapped with no way out], for no reason beyond [Because you were home|origin|strangers who arrive].
